hypothesis: Replacing a_v186's fixed calendar thresholds with hysteretic switches driven by workload utilization, deadline slack, expiry, shed pressure, terminal bankability, price, and opponent pressure will start harvesting/conservation earlier in overloaded states and continue profitable growth longer in slack states, improving win rate while reducing phase-boundary errors.

exact_code_lever.replace: Replace CASH_WAVE_END_DAY=24, RELAX_DAY=18, DUMP_STEP=648, FINAL_FARM_STEP=696, day>=20 crop-cap logic, and step-based terminal multipliers with compute_regime(metrics).
exact_code_lever.states: RECOVERY, GROWTH, BALANCED, HARVEST_CONSERVE, and LIQUIDATE.
exact_code_lever.entry_rules: RECOVERY if any survival job slack<=2. GROWTH if p90 mandatory utilization<0.65, minimum slack>=12, shed<65, and positive terminally feasible project exists. BALANCED for utilization 0.65-0.80 or slack 6-12. HARVEST_CONSERVE if utilization>=0.80, slack<=6, expiring bankable value>=1,000, shed>=80, or adverse price forecast. LIQUIDATE when remaining turns <= p90 harvest+travel+deposit+sell chain+4-turn buffer.
exact_code_lever.hysteresis: Enter immediately for RECOVERY/LIQUIDATE; otherwise require two consecutive replans. Exit only after the triggering metric clears by 0.10 utilization or 4 slack turns for two replans.

affected_phase: Potentially all days/hours. Most changes occur around land/animal expansion, the baseline days 18-24 relaxation/cash wave, service congestion days 15-20, price shocks, shed saturation, and terminal steps 648-719. No opponent identity is used; only visible state and market pressure.
engine_mechanism: Fixed days are proxies for coupled constraints: hands reset daily; every asset creates service/travel; crops have maturity/decay; animals need feed; harvested goods require cargo/shed/sale; market prices depend on both players and town; and unsold inventory is worthless at termination. Exact step deadlines remain hard invariants, but economic phase should depend on whether work can finish and be banked, not the calendar alone.
regime_trigger_and_forecast_error: At each replan store regime, entry metric, predicted workload/price/shed/expiry/terminal chain, realized next-window values, and signed error. If workload is underforecast >15% or terminal completion underforecast >4 turns, bias toward the more conservative regime for the rest of the day. If price error >25%, stop new affected premium projects until two accurate forecasts. Threshold adaptation is training-only [uncertain].
decision_score_audit: Log every metric in normalized units, active threshold, hysteresis counter, previous/new regime, transition reason, best admitted/rejected project, job score gaps, and actions enabled/disabled. If multiple triggers fire, precedence is RECOVERY > LIQUIDATE > HARVEST_CONSERVE > BALANCED > GROWTH. Record rejected transitions and counterfactual fixed-calendar regime.
admissible_workload_and_minimum_slack: Regime metrics come from deadline-feasible demand bounds, not raw open-job count. GROWTH requires p90 utilization<0.65 and slack>=12; BALANCED admits only projects leaving utilization<=0.80 and slack>=6; HARVEST_CONSERVE and RECOVERY add no recurring load; LIQUIDATE reserves an exact bankability chain. Threshold values need empirical calibration [uncertain].
constraint_utilization_profile: Per regime report worker/movement/cash/tile/shed/cargo/order utilization. Expected profiles: GROWTH has labor<65%, shed<65%; BALANCED labor<80%; HARVEST_CONSERVE sheds commitments and targets shed<75%; LIQUIDATE reserves market orders and return routes. Any hard capacity violation forces RECOVERY or LIQUIDATE.
job_queue_health: Report queue count/value, age, deadlines, slack, lateness, starvation, and abandonment by regime. GROWTH permits development; BALANCED caps it; HARVEST_CONSERVE abandons negative-net discretionary jobs; RECOVERY services threatened assets; LIQUIDATE keeps only bankable harvest/return/sell. Measure transition-induced cancellations and plan churn.
spatial_logistics_metrics: Use p90 route duration, distance/completed job, empty travel, switches, batch size, and shed trips in triggers. A dispersed farm with high travel can enter conservation despite low raw job count; a clustered farm can remain in growth longer. LIQUIDATE is triggered by the slowest valuable carrier's bankability chain.
expected_terminal_value: Transition only if estimated terminal value of the new regime exceeds staying by a switch margin of 500 coins or feasibility requires it. Expected cash/win uplift is not measured [uncertain].
marginal_value_per_worker_turn: Regime comparison uses the marginal terminal value of its enabled job set divided by service+travel actions. Growth ends when best new recurring project falls below reserved harvest/survival capacity value. Realized values are [uncertain].
shadow_price_vector: Regime triggers can be interpreted as resource shadow-price changes: labor/movement/shed/order prices rise sharply as utilization and deadlines tighten; tile and money prices fall near liquidation because new long projects cannot mature. Estimate phase-specific values by finite difference and smooth inside hysteresis bands [uncertain].
gross_to_net_value_decomposition: For each transition compare gross production retained/foregone with expiry rescue, service/movement, financing, shed/cargo overflow, price impact, displaced jobs, and terminal bankability. Log forecast and realized decomposition to identify premature liquidation versus late overload.
market_and_opponent_dependence: Price-floor risk, town absorption, and visible opponent incoming supply can enter HARVEST_CONSERVE; high current price and absorption can advance harvest, while temporarily depressed but recoverable price can favor hold if shed and deadlines allow. Opponent archetype is only an analysis stratum, not a direct rule.
action_validity_and_noop_breakdown: Regime filters must not create invalid actions: recovery checks inputs and exact tile state; conservation cancels stale queued work; liquidation checks cargo/shed adjacency and sellable shed quantity. Instrument attempted/valid/executed/no-op by regime and reason. Candidate results are [uncertain].
micro_scenario_coverage: Tests: day-18 farm overloaded versus idle; day-27 cargo adjacent versus remote; high-price early harvest; low-price recoverable hold; expiring crop; threatened animal; shed 95; zero market-order slots; dispersed SE land; shop unlock shock; opponent premium glut; fixed metrics inside hysteresis band; simultaneous recovery/liquidation precedence; and oscillating utilization.
terminal_feasibility: LIQUIDATE begins when p90 remaining chain plus four-turn buffer reaches remaining season time, not automatically at step 648. Exact last-step safety still blocks new projects and values unsold cargo at zero. Every valuable worker gets a latest departure and sell deadline; missed latest-start immediately sheds lower-value cargo work.
paired_test_design: Compare a_v186 to a candidate changing only regime computation while keeping job values and routes fixed. Use 1,536 paired seat outcomes across six opponent strata. Primary win uplift; secondary transition timing, time/regime, late jobs, terminal unsold value, and fixed-versus-endogenous counterfactual.
paired_discordance_and_effect_interval: Report candidate-only/control-only wins, paired uplift and 95% cluster interval; approximate MDE 3.2-5.0 points depending discordance. Also estimate uplift for episodes where endogenous and fixed regimes differ. Results are [uncertain].
random_stream_alignment: Regime changes occupancy and harvesting, so official same seeds can lose semantic weed-stream alignment. Use event-keyed exogenous draws or audit by event key and cluster inference. Regime transitions and tie-breaking must be deterministic for identical states.
optional_stopping_and_multiple_testing_b: Tune no more than four predeclared threshold bundles and two hysteresis margins on training data using successive halving. Freeze one candidate. If several share validation, Holm-correct the family; no early confirmatory promotion based on repeated fixed-time looks.
tuning_validation_separation: Fit forecast-error corrections and threshold bundles only on training opponents/seeds. Freeze state definitions, precedence, hysteresis, and terminal buffer before validation. Final confirmation uses fresh opponent hashes/seeds and no threshold updates.
distributional_guardrails: Require fewer or equal survival misses, no increase in regime switches above six/episode median, no seat/stratum win loss >3 points, terminal unsold median no higher, 10th-percentile cash not lower >2,000, and catastrophic loss not up >1 point. Results are [uncertain].
robustness_regret: Report regret of frozen thresholds versus best threshold bundle per stratum and versus a_v186, plus premature-liquidation regret and late-overload regret. No results exist [uncertain].
rare_event_stress_results: Stress abrupt shop/price shocks, dense weeds, worker/cash shortage, high shed load, simultaneous expiries, remote cargo, and day-29 premium rebound. Desired response is immediate recovery/liquidation when feasibility breaks and hysteretic stability otherwise. Measured results are [uncertain].
interaction_and_ablation_matrix: Ablate utilization, slack, expiry, shed, price, and terminal-chain triggers plus hysteresis. Test interactions with workload admission, hiring reservation, rolling horizon, and shadow-price scoring. Effects are [uncertain].
promotion_margin_and_reversion_trigger: Promote with >=+5-point paired win uplift, lower bound >0, fewer/equal survival and terminal failures, stable switching, and every stratum non-inferior. Revert if transition oscillation exceeds 10/episode, endogenous liquidation increases terminal unsold value, a survival miss is caused by staying in growth, or live win rate drops >5 points/100 games.
confidence_and_status: High confidence that fixed calendar phases are structurally brittle; medium confidence in the proposed thresholds/hysteresis. Implementation: proposed. Benchmark: not run. Status: experiment only [uncertain].
computational_budget: Metric computation O(jobs+tiles), target <10 ms and <2 MB. Evaluate at most four scheduled times/day plus material events. Persist only previous regime, counters, and forecast errors. If metrics are missing or time is short, choose the more conservative of fixed a_v186 phase and last feasible regime; RECOVERY/LIQUIDATE safety rules always run.
